title: Controlled Substance Ordering System electronic orders
rule_summary: CSOS permits a properly credentialed registrant or authorized subscriber to issue digitally signed electronic Schedule I and II orders in place of paper DEA Form 222.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply csos requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Controlled Substance Ordering System electronic orders

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing csos with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
